country.name: Seychelles

default_in_force_rule.text: Not applied: every version is dated by SeyLII's own expression date, the day the amendment it incorporates took effect as SeyLII (Laws.Africa) records it. No date is computed from a default rule.

country.licence_note: Source: SeyLII (https://seylii.org), licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International licence (CC BY-NC 4.0).

sources.name: SeyLII, Seychelles Legal Information Institute (Laws.Africa Peachjam platform, read through the Internet Archive)
sources.licence: CC BY-NC 4.0, crediting SeyLII as the source (SeyLII terms of use, s. 9, archived https://web.archive.org/web/20260301144011id_/https://seylii.org/terms-of-use/)
sources.notes: Point-in-time expressions of each act, /akn/sc/act/<work>/eng@<date>. In 2026 SeyLII moved from Peachjam to Lexum's Decisia/Norma platform, so these Peachjam pages exist only as Internet Archive captures; each version is read from the newest archived copy of its own expression page (raw id_ form), with the capture timestamp and sha256 pinned in sources.json. The request count covers every archive.org request (CDX and pages).

sources.name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine
sources.licence: Archived copies of SeyLII pages; the content licence is SeyLII's
sources.notes: CDX API for discovery, then https://web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>id_/<original url> for the page bytes, through scripts/gitlaw_common/wayback.py (one adaptive request rate for the whole machine). Common Crawl's index did not connect from this machine on 2026-10-28, so no Common Crawl copy is used.

acts.title: Constitution of the Republic of Seychelles
acts.label: Constitution of 1993

decisions: SeyLII files the Constitution of 1993 as /akn/sc/act/si/1993/38; every one of its 15 expressions (1993-06-21 to 2025-07-04) has an Internet Archive copy, so each version is read from its own dated expression. In 2023-24 SeyLII also showed the Constitution at /akn/sc/act/1994/7 (2 expressions), a number it later gave to the First Amendment Act 1994; those pages are not used.

The Constitution as adopted in 1993 is credited as kind 'law' (SeyLII files it among its Acts, in the S.I. series); the commit names it 'Constitution of 1993'. No referendum or assent date is taken from outside the source.

Licence and terms: SeyLII licensed its content CC BY-NC 4.0 with attribution, and its terms of use (archived 2026-03-01) prohibit scraping and bulk downloading; its robots.txt sends Content-Signal ai-train=no and disallows ClaudeBot and other AI crawlers. No SeyLII document page was fetched: every version is read from the Internet Archive's copy, for the configured acts only. The user decided on 2026-10-28 that reading these archived copies is acceptable (relayed by the coordinator: "scraping wayback is fair game, dont overdo it"). The repository stays private; CC BY-NC allows only non-commercial use. No legal text was given to a model.
ai_use: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5, claude-opus-5-5) wrote fetch.py and the configuration and chose the acts. No model wrote, summarised or transformed legal text: parse.py is deterministic code (the shared adapter scripts/africa-law/peachjam.py).
